items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: I have a little story here from Don Alias.

ctx.x: On film work a lot of the times, yeah. Film work yeah. But on records yes, sometimes there is sometimes they may say, “Hey by the way do you have udus?” You know it’s this clay pot, you know it’s something special they would ask. Yeah, yeah. Okay, I think we’re going to need some of those you know. But I have a really good assortment of stuff that I send. So a lot of times I’m not really missing much of what they need. You know but at times they do ask for certain things, they may ask for a frame drum. You know,…
I have a little story here from Don Alias.
